summary: MKDWELL Tech Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $100,000,000 of ordinary shares through Maxim Group LLC as sales agent, under a September 11, 2026 Sales Agreement. Agent commissions tier from 3.0% to 2.5% by proceeds. Nasdaq closing price was $5.10 on September 10, 2026, versus $9.90 on September 9. The company had 34,198,442 ordinary shares outstanding as of September 9, 2026, with a non-affiliate public float of $75,673,927. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and Nasdaq minimum-price compliance.
